meta.name: work-pipeline
meta.description: Triggers the WORK-PIPELINE when a user request starts with a [] tag (e.g., [new-feature], [bugfix], [WORK start]). Use this skill whenever you detect a [] tag at the beginning of a user message.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用方括号标签自动触发工作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常用方括号标签来启动特定工作流程
copy.tagline_en: Automatically trigger workflows with bracket tags
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use bracket tags to start specific workflows

howto.what: 装上后，当你的消息以方括号标签开头时，Claude 会启动一个工作流水线：先分析需求并创建文档，然后等待你批准，再按模式执行构建、验证、提交等步骤。
howto.when: 当你的消息以方括号标签（如 [new-feature]、[bugfix] 等）开头时触发。

say.text: [bugfix] 修复支付页面崩溃问题 auto
say.note: 末尾加“auto”可跳过所有审批步骤自动执行。

howto.what_en: When your message starts with a square bracket tag, Claude triggers a work pipeline: it analyzes the requirement, creates documents, waits for your approval, then executes build, verify, commit steps based on the mode.
howto.when_en: Triggered when your message starts with a square bracket tag (e.g., [new-feature], [bugfix]).

say_en.note: Claude analyzes the requirement and creates Requirement.md.
